description: A word's endings: counts, the key endings, and the endings the word is available on and for sale on. Use it when someone is naming a business, product or project and has a word in mind: it shows which endings, such as .com, .io or .ai, are still available or for sale for that word. Its lists `availableOn` and `forSaleOn` name every ending the word is open on, so one call answers the whole question. Pass `word` (such as organic); the other inputs are optional.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: byGroup, keyEndings, openByEnding, availableOn, forSaleOn, cheapest.

word.description: The catalog slug, the word, or `wrd_<id>`.

name: ud_get_word_endings

availableOn.description: `availableOn` names the endings where the word is unregistered at the standard price.

byGroup.description: Null for a word with no count yet; zeros are real.

forSaleOn.description: `forSaleOn` names the endings where it can be bought another way: at a premium price, from a resale listing, or as a name that is expiring or expired.

openByEnding.description: `{ ending: count }`; null for a word with no count yet; zeros are real.
